Hu Shi on society

Hu Shi (1891–1962) approaches society within Chinese pragmatism. He opposed dogma in favor of bold hypotheses and careful verification, applying pragmatism to culture and politics. Systematically, the teaching links pragmatism, language, reform into a practical and theoretical whole. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets society most directly—useful for searches such as “hu shi quotes on society.”

How to use this page

Start with the shortest passage, then compare tone across sources. Return to the Hu Shi thinker page for biography and to the society theme for other voices on the same question.
